visual_overrides.core_identity: A rooted predatory fungus that resembles a large mushroom until several long whip-like tendrils lash from the upper stalk.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Thick mushroom stalk and cap with multiple long narrow tendrils extending outward in broad readable curves.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Rooted fungal stalk with cap and several flexible tendrils emerging around the upper stalk.
visual_overrides.surface: Simple cap and stalk with sparse spots; tendrils smooth and uncluttered.
must_keep: clear contrast between cap and tendrils

scene_overrides.natural_posture: The mushroom base stays firmly rooted while tendrils extend from the upper stalk without replacing the fungal body.
behavior_style: reaching toward one nearby object with a small number of separated tendrils
waiting rooted while tendrils arc through open negative space
